name: ArtOnBar — bars of the Algarve
description: Every bar listed on artonbar.com with town, vibes, price tier, rating, winter opening and coordinates. Ratings are the guide's own rating where reviewed, Google ratings where noted on the page.
license: Free to use with attribution and a link to artonbar.com

bars.name: Forbidden Door
bars.desc: The only real speakeasy in the Algarve. No sign, ring the bell, serious cocktails €12–15.

bars.name: KasBah Bar
bars.desc: Moroccan décor that should be tacky but isn't. Salt-rimmed espresso martini, marina view free.

bars.name: Alma Lounge Bar
bars.desc: Open Friday and Saturday only. Tiny, intimate, custom cocktails. Locals know.

bars.name: Skybar Lagos
bars.desc: Hotel rooftop with a small pool and great views. Cash only. Go for the sunset.

bars.name: Indigo Bar
bars.desc: Day-to-night rooftop: coffee in the morning, cocktails by 9. Ask for the passionfruit daiquiri.

bars.name: Zanzibar
bars.desc: Rock music, cocktails named after movies, open till 4am. Happy hour 7–10pm.

bars.name: Pepper's Bar
bars.desc: Three floors and a rooftop terrace with sea views over Lagos old town. Sunset party institution.

bars.name: Sal Rosa
bars.desc: Cliff-edge terrace, Algarve botanicals in the glass. Book the front tables for sunset.

bars.name: Roca Beach Bar
bars.desc: On the sand at Praia da Oura. Beach club by day, sundowners by evening.

bars.name: By The Sea
bars.desc: Old-town terrace bar above the beach. The relaxed alternative to the Strip.

bars.name: The Argo
bars.desc: Award-winning cocktail bar at the Tivoli Marina — the best cocktail menu in the region.

bars.name: Baracuda Bar
bars.desc: Marina-front stalwart — the oldest bar on the Vilamoura boardwalk.

bars.name: Casino Vilamoura Bar
bars.desc: Late-night drinks till 3am with the casino floor next door.

bars.name: LAB Terrace
bars.desc: Faro's best sunset rooftop. €5 wine facing the Ria Formosa. Closes 8pm — sunset only.

bars.name: Cidade Velha Rooftop
bars.desc: Old-town rooftop with cathedral views. The Faro rooftop that stays open after sunset.

bars.name: Terrazzo Rooftop
bars.desc: Marina views and a polished cocktail list. Faro's late-evening rooftop option.

bars.name: Arcada Cocktail Club
bars.desc: Terrace on Tavira's main square. The best cocktail bar east of Faro.

bars.name: Rooftop Nomad
bars.desc: Rooftop restaurant-bar above Tavira's old town with river and rooftop views.

bars.name: Quasi Bar
bars.desc: Cabanas de Tavira seafront, Ria Formosa views, DJ weekends. More local than tourist.

bars.name: Sky Bar Carvoeiro
bars.desc: Tivoli hotel rooftop above the cliffs. Panoramic Atlantic views, premium cocktails. Seasonal.

bars.name: Cocktail Garden
bars.desc: Freestyle bartending under palm trees. Tell them what you like, they build it.

bars.name: Levels Carvoeiro
bars.desc: Three floors on the beach square, 90 seconds from the sand. Serious Portuguese wine list.

bars.name: Outro Bar
bars.desc: Cliff-top above Praia da Rocha, open till 4am. The most dramatic beach-bar setting in the west.

bars.name: Mandala Lounge
bars.desc: Reported closed Oct 2026 (now the hotel's Oriental Terrace). Cliff-top sunset lounge at Praia da Rocha — shisha, cocktails, and a real food menu.

bars.name: Absolutely
bars.desc: Reported closed Oct 2026. Cocktail lounge in Praia da Rocha with a menu that outperforms the strip around it.

bars.name: Dromedário Bar
bars.desc: Sagres institution since 1985. House craft beer, creative cocktails, DJs in summer. Open till 2am, all year.

bars.name: Água Salgada
bars.desc: Seafood tapas and negronis by day, DJ and mirror ball by night. Closed Mondays.

bars.name: Pau de Pita
bars.desc: Rooftop terrace with sea view, caipirinhas and sangria, 80s nights. One of the few open in winter.

bars.name: Chiringuito Last Chance
bars.desc: Palm-parasol deck above Praia da Mareta. The Sagres sunset drink. Cash only, pricey for the town.

bars.name: Latino Bar
bars.desc: Beachfront promenade terrace, cocktails around €7, the Quarteira sunset spot.

bars.name: Teixeira Wine Bar
bars.desc: Seafront wine and tapas bar with oak-barrel tables, long happy hour, live music some nights.

bars.name: Baz & Minnie's Irish Bar
bars.desc: Irish pub just off the promenade: Guinness, sport, karaoke, quiz night. Cash only, open till 2am.

bars.name: Cadillac Bar
bars.desc: Rock-and-roll local with live music every night and cheap beer. The only Quarteira bar open till 4am.

bars.name: Casta Nova
bars.desc: Small-producer and natural Portuguese wines with cheese and bread. Early-evening only, closed weekends.

bars.name: Pombo Bar
bars.desc: Waterfront avenue bar with strong mojitos and sparkling sangria. Where Olhão's night ends.

bars.name: Le Panorama
bars.desc: Lagoon-side market terrace: €10 oysters, white sangria, the cheapest golden-hour seat in Olhão. Cash only.

bars.name: ZONA Cocktail Lounge
bars.desc: Cocktails at €7–9 in the red-brick market hall facing the marina. Olhão's sunset cocktail.
